Art. 10(1) requires design and construction to meet Annex III requirements when placed on the market or put into service.
Art. 10(2) sets Annex IV Part A documentation, Art. 25 assessment, Art. 21 declaration and CE marking (Art. 24).
Art. 10(3) sets 10 year retention and source code or programming logic on reasoned request.
Definition and Art. 18(1)-(3) match, including the non professional user exclusion in 18(3); the paraphrase has a stray quotation mark.
Art. 20(1) gives presumption of conformity for harmonised standards published in the OJ.
Art. 20(3) allows common specifications by implementing act only where standardisation failed or is late; 20(6) gives presumption.
Art. 20(9) presumes compliance with Annex III sections 1.1.9 and 1.2.1 under a Reg 2019/881 scheme, insofar as the certificate covers them.
Art. 21 matches: Annex V Part A model, updated, translated, single declaration, manufacturer assumes responsibility.
Art. 25(2) lists module B plus C, module H, or module G for Annex I Part A.
Art. 25(3) allows module A only with harmonised standards or common specifications covering all requirements; otherwise B+C, H or G.
Art. 25(4) applies module A to machinery not listed in Annex I.
Art. 6(7) puts a category in Part A if serious risk and at least one of conditions (a) to (d); otherwise Part B. Provision addresses the Commission, not manufacturers.
